Cardiac rehabilitation.recommendation: All ACS patients should participate in a medically supervised, structured, comprehensive, multidisciplinary exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation and prevention programme.

Lifestyle management.recommendation: ACS patients should adopt a healthy lifestyle, including stopping all smoking of tobacco; healthy diet (Mediterranean style); alcohol restriction; regular aerobic physical activity and resistance exercise; reduced sedentary time.

Smoking cessation support.recommendation: In smokers, offer follow-up support, nicotine replacement therapy, varenicline or bupropion, individually or in combination, should be considered.

high-dose statin.recommendation: Initiate or continue high-dose statin therapy as early as possible, regardless of initial LDL-C values.

LDL-C targets.recommendation: Aim to achieve LDL-C <1.4 mmol/L (<55 mg/dL) and to reduce LDL-C by ≥50% from baseline.

add ezetimibe if needed.recommendation: If LDL-C goal not achieved despite maximally tolerated statin after 4–6 weeks, addition of ezetimibe is recommended.

add PCSK9 inhibitor if needed.recommendation: If LDL-C goal not achieved despite maximally tolerated statin therapy and ezetimibe after 4–6 weeks, addition of a PCSK9 inhibitor is recommended.

intensify during hospitalization.recommendation: It is recommended to intensify lipid-lowering therapy during the index ACS hospitalization for patients who were on lipid-lowering therapy before.

Associated Conditions: Persistent elevated LDL-C despite maximally tolerated statin and ezetimibe
Acute coronary syndrome patients needing further LDL-C reduction
